offlineDraft.deviceDraftText: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present. Mould was observed again in the back bedroom, specifically worsening by the window. The landlord had not responded to two emails sent. A letter was found on the table, and the date of birth was on a form numbered 3/3/87. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the deadline for a benefits form last week, as indicated by a letter on the table. It was agreed that I will ring the landlord on Monday, and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday; Tomas Brandvold offered to help Maria Okonkwo-Reyes with the form. Rent arrears are a potential risk if the form is submitted late. A follow-up is scheduled for (date not put back).
